quotations.old_english: He geþohte ðæt he wolde on fellenum gegyrelan ealle his dagas his lífes alifian
quotations.english: he resolved that he would live all the days of his life in clothing of skins

source_text: a-lifian; p. ode; pp. od To live; vivere :-- He geþohte ðæt he wolde on fellenum gegyrelan ealle his dagas his lífes alifian he resolved that he would live all the days of his life in clothing of skins, Guthl. 4; Gdwin. 26, 13. v. a-libban.
